So check and play . Live at [Click-Me](https://viditvarshney.github.io/Reaction-Timer.github.io/) *** # Welcome to the **"Reaction-Timer"** This is the game which will make you attentive with the game . It is very interesting when you bored ... *** ## You have to click the shapes as fast as you can , your time of response wil be automatically noted and displayed on the left hand side *** > Here are the screenshots of the Game !... ![reaction](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/34159717/43367366-62ade7a8-9369-11e8-9d52-aabe76f742d7.JPG) Screenshot 1 ![reaction1](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/34159717/43367367-63108aca-9369-11e8-96a6-ba5fc79201bb.JPG) Screenshot 2 ## You are most welcome to modify and give the suggestions ..
